senses.gloss: (b. h. חָשַׂךְ) [to scrape off,] to diminish, deduct; to stint, withhold.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:3">Dem. VII, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:4">4</cite>) <he>וחוֹסֵךְ גרוגרת וכ׳</he> Ar. a. ed. Y. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <he>חוֹשֵׂךְ</he>, Ms. M. repeatedly <he>חתך</he>) and retains one fig (which he does not eat).
Ib. לא יַחְסוֹךְ (Var. same).—Part. pass. חָסוּךְ stripped, wanting.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:2">Kel. I, 2</cite> (<he>וחֲשׂוּכֵי</he>) <he>וחֲסוּכֵי בגדים</he> and to make unclean the persons alone but not their clothes.
<cite ref="Eruvin 28a">Erub. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>חֲסוּכֵי בנים</he> Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. <he>חשוכי</he>) those who want children, opp. <he>מרובי בנים</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:7">Tosef. Sot. VI, 7</cite> <he>ח׳ עליו הכתוב</he> the Biblical text (the Lord) spared him (did not rebuke him).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מְחַסְּכִין לו</he> they (in heaven) spare him.
<cite ref="Zevachim 6b">Zeb. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>חי׳ הכתוב</he> the Biblical law has regard to expenses; v. <cite ref="H00836"><he>חִיסָּכוֹן</he></cite>.
